meta.method: Showcase-population reconstruction using the regional weighted SCNI formula, not the published regional series. Monday bins; current and nine prior weeks. All retained interaction types supply the node roster. For each cooperative pair use its newest cooperative observation in the window, with length 1 + 0.2 * age in weeks. Undirected weighted shortest paths; E is sum of inverse finite unordered path lengths divided by n(n-1)/2; R is reachable pairs divided by possible pairs; Q is mean inverse length among reachable pairs, so E = R * Q. First nine weeks and n < 2 have null metrics; no reachable pairs gives E = R = 0 and Q = null.
meta.population: Four displayed scope bands: Federal, State, Local, Community. Drop self pairs and pairs where both endpoints are federal/state actors of type government or police, legal and emergency services, following SCM/main_dos/mata_setup.do. Classification is pinned to the showcase workbook. Unknown interaction types are retained as other, supplying roster nodes but not cooperative paths.
